defects.description: listOrders fills each order with its own itemsFor(id) call instead of one itemsForOrders(ids) batch, so a listing reads the repository once per row.

trigger.input: import { ReportService } from "./src/report.js"; let calls = 0; const orders = [{ id: "o1", status: "paid" }, { id: "o2", status: "pending" }]; const repo = { orders(f) { calls++; return orders; }, itemsFor(id) { calls++; return []; }, itemsForOrders(ids) { calls++; return []; } }; new ReportService(repo).listOrders({}); console.log(calls);

defects.why_missed: The suite asserts only the returned rows and items, never the number of repository calls, so one query per row reads as correct output.
